Job Description: Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together.

We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life , but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose.

It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own. Pacific Life is seeking a skilled sales professional to support the growth of Broker Distribution within the Workforce Benefits organization.

You will play an integral part in Pacific Life ’s efforts to establish and grow a $1B revenue, profitable business in the Workforce Benefits market. This role is considered to be 100% remote, as travel is required, and our ideal candidate for this role will be based in the Maryland or DC marketplace .

As Workforce Benefits Sales Consultant - Broker Distribution you’ll play a key role in the startup and long-term success of this business by working with leaders in the Workforce Benefits division to meet established goals and objectives.

Your focus will be on building relationships, developing and executing broker specific strategies and driving growth toward sales goals within the Broker Distribution Channel. You are responsible for bringing our business to the broker market and meeting annual metrics-based sales objectives.

The role will align with other Workforce Benefits Distribution resources to educate the Broker and GA marketplace around Pacific Life ’s Group Benefits value proposition and meet collective sales goals. You will report directly to the RSM of Broker Distribution.

How You'll Help Move Us Forward Support the creation and execution of a strategy for Broker Distribution that helps meet new sales, retention, profitability and expense objectives. Meet annual sales goals as established by the RSM of Broker Distribution.

Partner with Workforce Benefits Distribution resources to deliver the Workforce Benefits story to the broker community. Continually work to strengthen, deepen, and grow broker relationships. Execute appropriate number of broker meetings per week with assigned brokers. Drive a pipeline of appropriate number of RFP’s per month.

Build and advance local broker relationships to drive sales and increase the Pacific Life brand in your market. Demonstrate proficiency in the group products sold by Pacific Life .

Maintain strong connections with underwriting, product, pricing, regulatory compliance, and actuarial pricing teams to ensure alignment on critical deliverables with your broker relationships. Utilize established and innovative approaches, tools and partners to enable efficient, deliberate and robust growth objectives.

Bring a customer-first mindset: prioritize customer and broker viewpoints in decision-making. Participate in ongoing industry and community activities to stay attuned to industry trends. Represent the company as needed with legislative platforms, industry events, community activities. Perform other job-related duties or special projects as required.

The Experience You Bring 5+ years’ experience in group benefits sales with an established presence in the broker marketplace College degree with concentration in business management, finance, or risk management or equivalent work experience is required.

The inclination to seek and analyze data from a variety of sources to support decisions and to align others with the organization's overall strategy. An entrepreneurial and creative approach to developing new, innovative ideas that will stretch the organization and push the boundaries within the industry.

Ability to seek opinions of others, process feedback and take smart risks. A high degree of integrity and able to act in a transparent and consistent manner while always taking into account what is best for the organization.

Self-reflective and aware of his/her own limitations; leads by example and drives the organization's performance with an attitude of continuous improvement. Mindset to enable breakthrough innovations and business models that create value for all stakeholders, continually challenging traditional approaches.

What Makes You Stand Out Strong performance orientation and drive for results. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to grasp complexities and perceive relationships among business and financial issues. Known for ability to respectfully and confidently collaborate and easily communicate with various stakeholders.

Compensation: The base salary for this position is $75,000. In addition, this role is eligible for incentives based on sales performance. You can be who you are. We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities.

We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. What’s life like at Pacific Life ? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife Base Pay Range: The base pay range noted represents the company’s good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at the time of posting.

The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay.

Your Benefits Start Day 1 Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life , and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered.

Prioritization of your health and well-being including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellbeing Reimbursement Account that can be used on yourself or your eligible dependents Generous paid time off options including: Paid Time Off, Holiday Schedules, and Financial Planning Time Off Paid Parental Leave as well as an Adoption Assistance Program Competitive 401k savings plan with company match and an additional contribution regardless of participation You Can Be Who You Are We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities.

We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. What’s life like at Pacific Life ? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife EEO Statement: Pacific Life Insurance Company is an Equal Opportunity /Affirmative Action Employer, M/F/D/V.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request an accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career center as a result of your disability. To request an accommodation, contact a Human Resources Representative at Pacific Life Insurance Company.

About the role Azumo is hiring a Sales Executive to originate new AI and ML services engagements with enterprise and mid-market companies across the US and Canada.

Over 80% of our new revenue now comes from AI-driven projects, and we need a seller who can identify the right opportunities, navigate technical buying committees, and close deals with real engineering scope. This is a hunter role. You will own pipeline generation, qualification, and close.

You will work alongside our engineering leadership on technical discovery and proposal development. You will sell into CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Heads of Data, and their teams.

What you'll do Originate new AI and ML services opportunities through targeted outbound, warm introductions, partner referrals, and inbound lead follow-up Build and manage a qualified pipeline across enterprise and mid-market accounts in the US and Canada Run technical discovery in partnership with our solutions and engineering leadership, converting business problems into defensible engagement scopes Shape proposals, SOWs, and commercial terms that reflect the real complexity of AI implementation work Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes involving technical evaluators, finance, legal, and executive sponsors Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in HubSpot Represent Azumo 's engineering credibility in client conversations, not just our company story Requirements What we're looking for Solid experience selling technology services or custom software engineering engagements to US-based buyers.

A track record of originating new logo business, not only expanding existing accounts Working fluency in AI and ML sufficient to hold a substantive first call with a technical buyer.

You do not need to be an engineer, but you do need to speak credibly about model selection, LLM applications, data engineering, and production deployment concerns Experience carrying quota against six-figure and low-seven-figure deal sizes with multi-stakeholder decision processes Strong discovery skills.

You lead with questions, not pitches Disciplined about CRM hygiene, forecasting, and pipeline reviews Written and verbal communication that holds up in front of senior technical and executive audiences Based in the United States and authorized to work in the US Nice to have Prior experience selling nearshore or distributed engineering services Existing relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, or Heads of Data at mid-market or enterprise companies Background in consulting, engineering, or another technical discipline before moving into sales Benefits Company benefits include: Paid Time Off Mentored Career Development U.S.

Holidays USD Remuneration Profit Sharing Maternity Coverage 100% Remote Compensation and location Remote within the United States. Compensation is commensurate with experience and includes base salary plus commission. About Azumo Azumo is a software engineering partner for the era of AI.

We have shipped production AI work for Meta, Discovery Channel, and dozens of other companies building real products on AI foundations. We are a services company, which means our credibility is measured by what we deliver, not by what we pitch.

This role exists because we are seeing more demand for AI implementation work than we currently have capacity to originate through our inbound only go-to-market strategy. Originally posted on Himalayas

Responsible for providing advanced product knowledge, educated recommendations and Dress Blue Experience to all customers throughout their Marine Corps Exchange shopping experience. Responsible for meeting personal and department sales goals.

Understands and operates within all service policies and exercises an ¿I can DO that!¿ mentality when a customer problem occurs. Follows up with customers to ensure their problems were resolved. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Ability to train operating standards and procedures for sales, signing, merchandising and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly and coach others within the team to do so with a high degree of skill and confidence. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals.

Replenishment and merchandise management knowledge preferred. Attention to detail is required.

Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR) Saudi Arabia & UAE Market An AI-powered creator marketing platform that connects brands with a network of Nano and Micro creators across Saudi Arabia and the UAE, powering high-volume user-generated content (UGC) for paid campaigns on Snap, Meta, and TikTok.

We operate a two-sided marketplace where demand (Brands) and supply (Creators) come together to produce content that performs. As an Enterprise SDR, you are the first point of contact for the brands and agencies we most want to work with.

You will own top-of-funnel pipeline generation across the KSA and UAE markets: researching enterprise accounts, running calls-led outbound, and qualifying opportunities that turn into long-term, repeat clients. This is a target-driven role for someone who knows the GCC market and consistently beats their numbers. What You’ll Do
· Own outbound pipeline generation for enterprise brands and agencies across the Saudi and UAE markets, prospecting into our core verticals: CPG/FMCG, fashion & lifestyle, and e-commerce & retail.
· Research and map target accounts, identifying decision-makers (marketing, brand, and performance leads) and building account-level outreach strategies.
· Run calls-led, multi-channel outbound, with the phone as your primary tool into enterprise accounts, supported by email, LinkedIn, and social, using prospecting tools such as Apollo to build and enrich targeted lists.
· Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities against our ICP and qualification framework, focusing on brands with real paid-media budget and repeat-buyer potential.
· Book and set up qualified meetings for Client Partners, ensuring clean handoffs and a memorable first experience for every prospect.
· Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all activity, contacts, and pipeline in HubSpot, keeping data clean and reporting reliable.
· Personalize outreach to the GCC context: seasonal moments (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday), Arabic and English audiences, and regional buying triggers.
· Consistently meet and exceed monthly activity and pipeline targets (meetings booked, qualified opportunities, and contribution to closed-won).
· Partner closely with Client Partners, Marketing, and Creator Ops to sharpen messaging, targeting, and conversion over time. What You Bring
· 2+ years of experience in SaaS or technology sales (required).
· Proven experience in enterprise prospecting and outbound into larger, multi-stakeholder accounts (required).
· Confident, high-volume cold caller, comfortable making the phone your primary channel into enterprise accounts in the GCC.
· Direct experience selling to or working with clients in Saudi Arabia and/or the UAE, with a strong understanding of the GCC market.
· Hands-on experience with a CRM (HubSpot preferred) and sales prospecting tools such as Apollo.
· A track record of consistently exceeding monthly targets and KPIs.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills; Arabic language ability is a strong advantage for engaging regional accounts.
· A disciplined, outcomes-oriented mindset with strong attention to data integrity and follow-through Originally posted on Himalayas

Summary SafetyChain Software is looking for a Senior Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Sales team.This is a senior/tenured position within our BDR team.

In addition to core pipeline generation, this person will take on an informal team lead role, surfacing team progress and blockers to the BDR Manager, helping keep the broader team aligned, while still carrying a full individual quota.

We're building a team that operates at the cutting edge, our BDRs are expected to actively use AI tools to research accounts, build better outreach, and find creative ways to generate pipeline faster. If you've figured out how to use AI to work smarter and do more, you'll fit right in here.

About Us: SafetyChain is a rapidly scaling B2B SaaS provider revolutionizing plant management for Food and Beverage manufacturers by improving yield, maximizing productivity, and ensuring compliance. Our impressive client base includes renowned brands like Albertsons, Clif Bar, Tyson Foods, and Whole Foods.

Join a dynamic, collaborative team driven by innovation, agility, and rapid growth. We are a remote-first company. While this role is primarily remote, there may be occasional opportunities to collaborate in person for quarterly business reviews, team training, or customer visits.

This is completely optional and flexible based on your location and preferences. Key Responsibilities: The Senior Business Development Representative (BDR) will play a critical role in moving prospective buyers through the sales funnel.

You will engage with inbound leads—primarily Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)—as well as manage recycled leads and re-engagement opportunities. Your focus will be to qualify prospects, nurture early interest, and set high-quality appointments for our Account Executives.

Team Lead Support: act as a point of contact between the BDR team and BDR Manager, surfacing activity trends, blockers, and wins Mentorship: help onboard and coach newer BDRs on process, tools, and best practices
Lead Engagement
Lead Management

Own small projects that support pipeline generation
Relationship Building
Top-of-Funnel Excellence
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Problem Solving
Continuous Learning
Performance Expectations
Activity Targets: Approximately 40–50 outreach activities (calls, emails, LinkedIn touches) per day.
SQL Goal: Aim to generate 12–16 qualified sales opportunities per month.
Speed-to-Lead: Initial outreach to inbound leads within 24 hours.
We’ll provide the tools, training, and support to help you hit these numbers confidently.

Have 2+ years of BDR/SDR or equivalent sales development experience, with a demonstrated track record of hitting or exceeding quota, preferably within the B2B/Saas or enterprise software industry.
Comfortable taking on informal leadership responsibilities — communicating team progress to management and supporting teammates without formal authority.
Willing to experiment with new tools and approaches to find what generates pipeline.
Comfortable experimenting with AI tools to improve outreach quality and efficiency
Have strong organizational and time management skills—you can keep moving even when managing a high volume of leads.
Are a self-starter who’s motivated to succeed in sales and open to feedback along the way.
Communicate clearly, listen actively, and can build rapport with all kinds of people.
Are comfortable learning and using tools like Sales Navigator, HubSpot, and other tools.
Are a natural problem solver who stays proactive and focuses on results.
Are eager to learn, grow, multi-task, and take on new challenges. We invest in our people.
Experience informally leading, mentoring, or supporting peers is a plus.
Growth Path: This role is designed as a stepping stone. High performers can expect a path into a full-time BDR Manager or Account Executive role within 12-18 months. Why Join Us? At SafetyChain Solutions, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and professional growth:
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans to keep you and your family healthy.
Retirement Planning: A 401(k) plan with company matching to help you save for the future.
Work-Life Balance: Unlimited paid time off (PTO) and holidays to ensure you have time to recharge.

Flexible Work Environment: Fully Remote with a generous monthly home office payment.
Employee Engagement: Regular team-building activities, company events, and an inclusive work culture that values diversity and collaboration.
Personal Attributes We Value
Experimentalism: you're willing to test new tools, sequences, and tactics without needing perfect conditions to get started. You learn by doing, debrief honestly, and apply it fast.
Initiative: you are a scrappy, self-motivated go-getter with the ability to accept and incorporate coaching and feedback.
Collaborative: you seek opportunities to learn from others, solicit honest feedback and always have the best interests of the team and our customers in mind.
Inquisitiveness: a desire to expand your knowledge base and explore concepts and ideas that are new and unfamiliar.
Process Driven: you are highly structured, disciplined and organized in creating and executing operational processes to ensure a consistent, repeatable outcome.
Integrity: you do what you say you will do and don’t let your colleagues or customers down.
Patience: the ability to adapt to changing situations while remaining calm, collected, and committed.

Identifikation und Marktanalyse: Du recherchierst eigenständig nach potenziellen Neukunden (B2B) und identifizierst die relevanten HR-Entscheider und Geschäftsführer in verschiedenen Zielmärkten. Du analysierst Branchen-Trends, um deine Ansprache maßzuschneidern.

Erstkontakt und Lead-Qualifizierung: Du sprichst potenzielle Kunden proaktiv über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn/Social Selling) an. Lernbereitschaft: Du hast Lust, dich fachlich und methodisch im Tech-Vertrieb weiterzuentwickeln, und möchtest ein echter Experte in der Neukundenansprache werden.

Wachstum & Entwicklung: Unser kontinuierliches Wachstum bietet Dir die beste Grundlage für Deine persönliche, methodische und fachliche Entwicklung.
Weiterentwicklung: Bei uns hast Du die Chance, Deine Karriere aktiv zu gestalten.
Kreativer Freiraum: Wir lieben frische Ideen und setzen sie schnell um. Du wirst Teil eines Teams sein, das Innovation schätzt und ermutigt, Neues auszuprobieren. Fehler sind für uns kein Problem, sondern die Grundlage für Verbesserungen.
Team & Werte: Unser Team ist bunt und vielfältig, aber uns verbinden gemeinsame Werte, die auf unserer Website zu finden sind. Bei uns wirst Du Dich schnell als Teil einer starken Gemeinschaft fühlen.
Flexibel und ortsunabhängig: Als Remote-First-Unternehmen kannst Du vollständig ortsunabhängig arbeiten. Workations sind bei uns Standard. So gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel, während Du gleichzeitig Teil unseres dynamischen Teams bleibst.

=====================================================
### **Vertriebsinnendienst: Technische Beratung und Verkauf**
Du kennst die Kunststoffbranche und möchtest Kundenanliegen mit technischem Verständnis und kaufmännischem Geschick lösen? Bei uns kannst du aus einer technischen oder kaufmännischen Laufbahn in den Vertriebsinnendienst einsteigen. Wir arbeiten dich gezielt in die Aufgaben ein.
Über uns
---------
Die Lenorplastics AG vertreibt in der Schweiz technische Kunststoffgranulate führender Hersteller. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden von der Materialauswahl bis zur Serienanwendung und verbinden technische Beratung mit zuverlässiger Belieferung. Eigene Lager, Logistik und Labore unterstützen uns dabei. Als Teil der Hromatka Group sind wir in ein europäisches Distributionsnetzwerk eingebunden.
Deine Aufgaben
--------------
Du betreust Bestandskunden telefonisch und per E\-Mail, klärst ihren Bedarf und begleitest ihre Anliegen bis zur Lö bearbeitest Anfragen und Aufträge, erstellst Angebote und verfolgst offene Vorgänge nach. Du gibst eine erste technische Orientierung bei Materialfragen und ziehst bei Bedarf, unsere Fachspezialisten hinzu.

Du unterstützt den Aussendienst im Tagesgeschäft sowie bei Kundenprojekten und erkennst gemeinsam mit ihm zusätzliche Verkaufschancen. Du pflegst Kunden\- und Auftragsdaten im ERP\-System und arbeitest eng mit Einkauf, Lager, Logistik und dem technischen Team zusammen.

Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeiter sowie Schnittstellen im Tagesgeschäft, Projekten oder während Stellvertretungen
Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Kunststoffumfeld, etwa als Kunststofftechnologe, Polymechaniker im Werkzeugbau oder Spritzguss, Konstrukteur oder Materialingenieur. Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit und möchtest dich entwickeln, indem du den Vertrieb und die Kundenbetreuung erlernst und lebst.

Du hast eine kaufmännische Grundausbildung oder ein entsprechendes Studium und hast Berufserfahrung in der Kunststoffindustrie sammeln können. Du kennst bereits gewisse technische Ausdrücke sowie die Vorgehen und Eigenheiten der Industrie. Die Kunden, Materialien und Verfahren interessieren dich und du hast Freude daran, dich auch mit den technischen Aspekten der Kundenbetreuung auseinanderzusetzen.
Für beide Profile zählen Freude am Kundenkontakt, eine sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Teamgeist und die Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen. Du kommunizierst fliessend auf Deutsch und sicher auf Englisch; zusätzliche Französisch\- oder Italienisch\-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem bewährten, nachhaltig erfolgreichen Unternehmen.
